body:
Good morning!

I baked early this morning, and now there are warm rolls for our neighbors. Would you help me fill their baskets? Each basket shows how many rolls it needs.

You will find me by the bakery in the village square.
summary: Help Mr. Tobias fill the neighbors' bread baskets.
done: Every neighbour has bread, and the dog and the hens are happy. Thank you!

tasks.text: Fill the bread baskets with Mr. Tobias
Pat the little dog in the village square
Scatter grain for the hens at home
